model_output.verdict: Your outpatient orthopedic and post-surgical rehab work is clear, and the patient load and program work back it up. I’d want to talk to you. I’d ask which function measures sit behind the discharge figures.
write_up: Your outpatient rehab work is easy to follow: you name the cases you treat, the program you built, and the therapists you mentor. That gives a clinic a concrete picture of both your patient care and your senior responsibilities!
The return-to-run line is the model for the rest: it names something you built and tells us how many patients completed it. Your Minnesota license and DPT are easy to find, too.
Add the measure and patient count behind the discharge figures if you have them. Your resume otherwise does its job; how competitive a particular clinic is will matter too.
